pages.title: Limestone
pages.text: Limestone lies under the sand, gravel or mud wherever oceans and rivers run deep enough. Any pickaxe will mine it. Smelt it into $(item)Smooth Limestone$(), and craft both into bricks, pillars and pedestals.
A pedestal's bordered top faces the side it is placed against. Click near the top or bottom edge of a side to stand it upright or upside down.

pages.title: Bauxite
pages.text: Bauxite is the ore of aluminium. It forms in veins of up to 8 blocks in stone between Y 64 and Y 255, so look in hills and mountains rather than caves. It needs a stone pickaxe.

pages.title: Rutile
pages.text: Rutile is the ore of titanium. It turns up now and then in the limestone of the sea bed, twice as often under rivers. It needs an iron pickaxe.

pages.title: Pearl Oysters
pages.text: Oysters sit on the ocean floor, and about one in three already holds something. Right-click one to take out what is inside. Put in a block of sand and, while water stays above it, the sand slowly turns into a pearl.

What an oyster makes depends on what it rests on. On a $(item)Pearl Block$() it always grows a pearl of that colour; on soul sand or red sand it makes more of that; in the End it makes ender pearls. Anywhere else the pearl's colour is random, and sometimes the sand just stays sand.$(br2)Oysters need a solid floor and water above them, or they pop off.

pages.title: Pearls
pages.text: Pearls come from $(item)Pearl Oysters$(). Four pearls of one colour make a $(item)Pearl Block$(), which can be turned back into four pearls, and four blocks make four $(item)Pearl Bricks$().
